g.text: Circular island: corrected geometry in the actual emitted cuts
The PML requests a 100 mm circular island inside a 240 × 240 mm pocket, 6 mm deep.
Red point now cleared to 6 mm depth
After: 1,440 radial samples range from 49.9995 to 50.0012 mm; NC allowance ±0.004 mm.
The nominal curve is polygonized outward within 0.001 mm, preserving the specified circle before NC rounding.
Same 12.7 mm cutter and 6 mm depth. The 320 × 320 mm blank, 40 mm rim and outside-profile program are unchanged.
Retained island reconstructed from emitted NC using 96-segment-quadrant flat-cutter sweeps. This is computational evidence.
Source/NC hashes and measurements: island-shape-measurements.json. No physical cut test is claimed.
